title: THC Advanced Water Quality and Irrigation Certificate
publicDescription: Demonstrates applied capability in water-quality interpretation, pH and EC verification, irrigation uniformity, mass-balance reasoning, root-zone trends, fertigation deviations, and controlled corrective-action escalation.
limitations: This Academy credential is educational and employment-oriented; it is not a government cannabis license or occupational license.
